description: Hardware-agnostic SMBIOS capability matrix for Intel desktop systems. Candidates are selected from CPU generation and GPU topology, never from a specific motherboard or machine identity.

smbios.reason: SMBIOS product selection depends on CPU generation, iGPU/dGPU topology, macOS support, and the exact workload path. Unique identifiers are always generated separately and are never stored in profiles.

when.cpuNameRegex: (?i)^8th Gen Intel\(R\) Core|^9th Gen Intel\(R\) Core

matrix.rationale: Dortania documents iMac19,1 as the Coffee Lake desktop SMBIOS for Mojave and newer and identifies it as the current Coffee Lake recommendation. It expects an iGPU topology.

Dortania documents iMac20,1 for Comet Lake systems up to 8 cores and recommends it over iMac20,2 except for the higher-core i9 class. This candidate is limited to hosts where the iGPU topology is actually present.

MacPro7,1 is the preferred SMBIOS path documented for iGPU-less modern Intel desktop configurations because it does not impose the iMac SMBIOS iGPU assumption. Alder Lake community configurations commonly use MacPro7,1. GPU compatibility must be validated independently; the SMBIOS profile does not assert that every dGPU is supported.

excludedGenerations.reason: No current Sequoia-native desktop SMBIOS candidate is selected automatically; older iMac SMBIOS generations are no longer current macOS targets.
No iGPU-less modern desktop SMBIOS candidate is asserted without a dGPU. The resolver remains NeedsValidation rather than guessing.
